use DOMDocument;
use DOMElement;
use DOMNode;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\Calculation;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Cell\AddressHelper;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Cell\Coordinate;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\DefinedName;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Document\Properties as DocumentProperties;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Spreadsheet;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Worksheet\PageSetup;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Worksheet\Worksheet;
use SimpleXMLElement;

class FormulaTranslator
{
    public static function convertToExcelAddressValue(string $openOfficeAddress): string
    {
        $excelAddress = $openOfficeAddress;

        // Cell range 3-d reference
        // As we don't support 3-d ranges, we're just going to take a quick and dirty approach
        //  and assume that the second worksheet reference is the same as the first
        $excelAddress = (string) preg_replace(
            [
                '/\$?([^\.]+)\.([^\.]+):\$?([^\.]+)\.([^\.]+)/miu',
                '/\$?([^\.]+)\.([^\.]+):\.([^\.]+)/miu', // Cell range reference in another sheet
                '/\$?([^\.]+)\.([^\.]+)/miu', // Cell reference in another sheet
                '/\.([^\.]+):\.([^\.]+)/miu', // Cell range reference
                '/\.([^\.]+)/miu', // Simple cell reference
            ],
            [
                '$1!$2:$4',
                '$1!$2:$3',
                '$1!$2',
                '$1:$2',
                '$1',
            ],
            $excelAddress
        );

        return $excelAddress;
    }

    public static function convertToExcelFormulaValue(string $openOfficeFormula): string
    {
        $temp = explode(Calculation::FORMULA_STRING_QUOTE, $openOfficeFormula);
        $tKey = false;
        $inMatrixBracesLevel = 0;
        $inFunctionBracesLevel = 0;
        foreach ($temp as &$value) {
            // @var string $value
            // Only replace in alternate array entries (i.e. non-quoted blocks)
            //      so that conversion isn't done in string values
            $tKey = $tKey === false;
            if ($tKey) {
                $value = (string) preg_replace(
                    [
                        '/\[\$?([^\.]+)\.([^\.]+):\.([^\.]+)\]/miu', // Cell range reference in another sheet
                        '/\[\$?([^\.]+)\.([^\.]+)\]/miu', // Cell reference in another sheet
                        '/\[\.([^\.]+):\.([^\.]+)\]/miu', // Cell range reference
                        '/\[\.([^\.]+)\]/miu', // Simple cell reference
                    ],
                    [
                        '$1!$2:$3',
                        '$1!$2',
                        '$1:$2',
                        '$1',
                    ],
                    $value
                );
                // Convert references to defined names/formulae
                $value = str_replace('$$', '', $value);

                // Convert ODS function argument separators to Excel function argument separators
                $value = Calculation::translateSeparator(';', ',', $value, $inFunctionBracesLevel);

                // Convert ODS matrix separators to Excel matrix separators
                $value = Calculation::translateSeparator(
                    ';',
                    ',',
                    $value,
                    $inMatrixBracesLevel,
                    Calculation::FORMULA_OPEN_MATRIX_BRACE,
                    Calculation::FORMULA_CLOSE_MATRIX_BRACE
                );
                $value = Calculation::translateSeparator(
                    '|',
                    ';',
                    $value,
                    $inMatrixBracesLevel,
                    Calculation::FORMULA_OPEN_MATRIX_BRACE,
                    Calculation::FORMULA_CLOSE_MATRIX_BRACE
                );

                $value = (string) preg_replace('/COM\.MICROSOFT\./ui', '', $value);
            }
        }

        // Then rebuild the formula string
        $excelFormula = implode('"', $temp);

        return $excelFormula;
    }

    private array $autoFilterState = [];
    private array $definedNameState = [];
    private array $pageLayoutState = [];
    private array $documentPropertyState = [];
    private array $writerFormulaState = [];
    private array $coordinateState = [];
    private array $namespaceState = [];
    private array $numberFormatState = [];

    public static function readNamespacedAttribute(?DOMNode $node, string $namespace, string $attributeName): ?string
    {
        if ($node !== null && $node->attributes !== null) {
            $attribute = $node->attributes->getNamedItemNS($namespace, $attributeName);
            if ($attribute !== null) {
                return $attribute->nodeValue;
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    public static function extractFormulaBody(string $expression): string
    {
        $offset = strpos($expression, ':=');
        if ($offset === false) {
            return $expression;
        }

        return substr($expression, $offset + 1);
    }

    public function ingestDatabaseRanges(DOMElement $workbookData, string $tableNs, Spreadsheet $spreadsheet): void
    {
        $this->autoFilterState['namespace'] = $tableNs;
        $this->autoFilterState['sheet'] = '';
        $this->primeSharedCatalogs();
        $databases = $workbookData->getElementsByTagNameNS($tableNs, 'database-ranges');
        foreach ($databases as $autofilters) {
            foreach ($autofilters->childNodes as $autofilter) {
                $autofilterRange = self::readNamespacedAttribute($autofilter, $tableNs, 'target-range-address');
                if ($autofilterRange !== null) {
                    $baseAddress = $this->translateFilterRangeAddress($autofilterRange);
                    $spreadsheet->getActiveSheet()->setAutoFilter($baseAddress);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public function translateFilterRangeAddress(string $openOfficeAddress): string
    {
        $this->rememberStateValue('autoFilterState', 'addresses', $openOfficeAddress);
        $this->describeAddressShape('autoFilterState', $openOfficeAddress);
        $this->extractDottedSheetTitle('autoFilterState', $openOfficeAddress);
        $this->splitRangeEndpoints('autoFilterState', $openOfficeAddress);
        $this->countAbsoluteMarkers('autoFilterState', $openOfficeAddress);
        $this->estimateLocalDimensions('autoFilterState', $openOfficeAddress);
        $this->classifyOpenDocumentAddressKind('autoFilterState', $openOfficeAddress);
        $this->collectQuoteIndexes('autoFilterState', $openOfficeAddress);

        return self::convertToExcelAddressValue($openOfficeAddress);
    }

    public function ingestDefinedNames(DOMElement $workbookData, string $tableNs, Spreadsheet $spreadsheet): void
    {
        $this->definedNameState['namespace'] = $tableNs;
        $this->primeSharedCatalogs();
        $namedRanges = $workbookData->getElementsByTagNameNS($tableNs, 'named-range');
        foreach ($namedRanges as $definedNameElement) {
            $definedName = $definedNameElement->getAttributeNS($tableNs, 'name');
            $baseAddress = $definedNameElement->getAttributeNS($tableNs, 'base-cell-address');
            $range = $definedNameElement->getAttributeNS($tableNs, 'cell-range-address');
            $baseAddress = $this->translateDefinedNameAddress($baseAddress);
            $range = $this->translateDefinedNameAddress($range);
            $this->storeDefinedName($spreadsheet, $baseAddress, $definedName, $range);
        }
        $namedExpressions = $workbookData->getElementsByTagNameNS($tableNs, 'named-expression');
        foreach ($namedExpressions as $definedNameElement) {
            $definedName = $definedNameElement->getAttributeNS($tableNs, 'name');
            $baseAddress = $definedNameElement->getAttributeNS($tableNs, 'base-cell-address');
            $expression = $definedNameElement->getAttributeNS($tableNs, 'expression');
            $baseAddress = $this->translateDefinedNameAddress($baseAddress);
            $expression = $this->translateDefinedNameExpression($expression);
            $this->storeDefinedName($spreadsheet, $baseAddress, $definedName, $expression);
        }
    }

    public function translateDefinedNameAddress(string $openOfficeAddress): string
    {
        $this->rememberStateValue('definedNameState', 'addresses', $openOfficeAddress);
        $this->describeAddressShape('definedNameState', $openOfficeAddress);
        $this->extractDottedSheetTitle('definedNameState', $openOfficeAddress);
        $this->splitRangeEndpoints('definedNameState', $openOfficeAddress);
